quests.name: test
quests.description: Test test test

quests.name: To exit
quests.description: You found yourself in abandoned auxiliary tunnels, all alone and without any equipment, and the most important - you have no clue how you ended up here. Find your way back to surface, and in the meantime try to scout this place for some useful and valuable stuff.

stages.text: Get to the exit to surface

quests.name: Contact locals
quests.description: Peaceful settlements should exist somewhere in the Equestrian Wasteland. They can be base camps for further operations. Find such a settlement and meet local ponies

quests.name: Chosen-24
quests.description: A few months earlier, the "Chosen-24" was entrusted with the same mission as you. But the signal from her PipBuck was lost seventy-two days ago. Your task is to find "Chosen-24" and find out the reasons why the contact with her is lost. Then proceed according to circumstances

stages.text: Explore the camp in the sewers

quests.name: Chasing the rainbow
quests.description: Somewhere in the vicinity of your landing point there must be a ManeTec factory or at least what is left of it. Your main goal is the central maneframe, its disks must contain the information that we require. Just connect your PipBuck, everything else will be done by the programs installed on it. So far this is all the information I can share with you. Attention! Do not try to take off your PipBuck! The success of the mission depends on it, and so does your life

stages.text: Find out the location of the ManeTec factory
Find and study maps of the factory
Enter the department of special research
Connect your PipBuck to the central maneframe

quests.name: The Quantum Cogitator
quests.description: Your main task now is to get hold of the Quantum Cogitator. It is an extremely powerful yet very compact processor capable of supporting artificial intelligence of the highest class. The only place where it can be obtained, according to our information, is Stable 88, known for its developments in the field of computers and robots with advanced AI. The entrance to Stable is somewhere in the town of Falls Springs

stages.text: Ask Daiquiri about the location of Falls Springs
Report to the Mentor about your success

quests.name: Meeting
quests.description: Send the Quantum Cogitator to our trusted person through his sprite-bot. The meeting place is Hankey garages

stages.text: Give the quantum cogitator to the sprite-bot
Inspect the remains of the sprite-bot

quests.name: Alicorn Amulet
quests.description: The new main task is to get the Alicorn Amulet, which is hidden somewhere in the ruins of Manehattan

stages.text: Ask Daiquiri about the road to Manehattan
Rise to the roof of one of the still standing skyscrapers and look around
Get to the entrance to the M.A.S. tower
Meet with the leader of alicorns

quests.name: The Black Book
quests.description: The new main task is to get the Black Book, an artifact of zebra necromancers. The last known location of the Book is the main office of the Ministry of Image, Canterlot

stages.text: Ask Calamity the directions to Canterlot

quests.name: Way back home
quests.description: Now that all the required components have been collected, you need to find a way to return home, to Stable Pi

stages.text: Attempt contacting the Mentor through the communication unit
Ask Watcher about the way home

quests.name: Steel Rangers
quests.description: It seems that the Elder of the local Steel Rangers division conspires with zebras of the Legion and plans an attack on Stable Pi! You must take measures at once

stages.text: Talk to SteelHooves in his camp
Find out about the new armor from Oak Stalwart
Enter the base of the Steel Rangers
Warn citizens of "Prancing Pony" about the danger
Warn citizens of Covertsign about the danger

quests.name: Aiding the "Prancing Pony"
quests.description: A serious talk requires serious arguments, like a couple of large caliber guns. Measures should be taken to ensure that the "Prancing Pony" camp is able to defend itself against the Steel Rangers

stages.text: Talk with Oak about the mission
Find and explore the Mane-Tech gun workshop

quests.name: Aiding Covertsign
quests.description: Covertsign has nothing to help them withstand the Legion`s might. Askari decided to gather a community council for discussing the situation and finding a solution

stages.text: Wait for the community council to gather
Ask Steelhoves about the location of the regional Legion headquarters

quests.name: Shadow of the Enclave
quests.description: Find out what the Pegasus Enclave forgot on the surface, what are its goals and what its presence means for all of us

stages.text: Visit the Enclave base and try to negotiate

quests.name: The storm is coming
quests.description: The Mentor refused to participate in some random wars on the surface. But you can`t just leave your new friends in danger while hiding in a safe Stable. You have to go back to the Wasteland

stages.text: Tell Velvet about the latest events
Meet SteelHooves at the water treatment plant

quests.name: The last battle
quests.description: The Enclave is attacking your home, Stable Pi. Protect it at all costs!

stages.text: Return to Stable Pi and find Mentor

quests.name: Make friends with a balefire phoenix
quests.description: The balefire phoenix, it seems, is not afraid of you and does not show any aggression. Rumors say, these birds are unusually intelligent and, with proper care, can become loyal friends. Try to make friends with one

quests.name: Rescue captives
quests.description: Raiders hold their captives in cages. Find a way to release them. Break cage locks or find a key

quests.name: Cure a sick zebra
quests.description: A zebra named Zira is seriously ill, and Velvet can do nothing to help her. Your knowledge of medicine will be very helpful

stages.text: Get the vaccine from dusty fever
Come after some time and ask Velvet about the patient

quests.name: Find armor schematics
quests.description: You need to find schematics for the secret armor, which are hidden somewhere in the destroyed factory. I presume, it is hidden the office of the factory CEO. Or not. But where else, if not there?

stages.text: Get armor schematics from the CEO`s safe
Bring back the schematics and get a reward

quests.name: Kill Mad Fox
quests.description: Have you heard about the Mad Fox gang? They say their lair is somewhere in the old factory. Whoever finds and finishes these degenerates off, would deserve my eternal gratitude

stages.text: Get a reward from Oak Stalwart

quests.name: Get the paint
quests.description: I`m looking for sprays with paint of different colors. For a start, the common ones will do

stages.text: Bring back all the paint and get a reward

quests.name: Get the paint - 2
quests.description: Again I`m looking for paint sprays, but now I require more rare colors

stages.text: Bring back all the paint and get a reward

quests.name: Get the paint - 3
quests.description: Another hunt for paint. I need special colors, see the list attached. As usual - you bright paint, I pay caps, but this time the reward is bigger

stages.text: Bring back all the paint and get a reward

quests.name: Power armor
quests.description: If you want to get a power armor specially created for you, get at least a few fragments of it. I do not care how you get them, but the electronic components must be in working condition

stages.text: Give Oak Stalwart the materials for the armor and wait for the completion of the work

quests.name: Destroy bloatsprites` lair
quests.description: Bloatsprites, that inhabit the ruins of the factory, recently started multiplying out of control. It`s time to end this! I`ll pay to anypony who finds a lair of bloatsprites and burns it once and for all

stages.text: Get a reward from Brass Buckshot

quests.name: Find a new focusing crystal
quests.description: A focusing crystal in my favorite plasma gun has cracked. I need a new one, the largest and purest of course. But if somepony tries to slip me a piece of glass again, prepare to get some shot in a rump

stages.text: Bring Brass the crystal and get a reward

quests.name: Kill Lucerne
quests.description: Many of you probably remember a pony named Lucerne. Once she was a good, decent ghoul, but now, it seems, the process of decay finally reached her brain, and she turned into a feral. They say she was seen in the sewers, in a place called "Pit", in the company of a whole herd of other ferals. It would be nice if somepony decided to end her time on earth - in present state she poses a considerable danger for all of us

stages.text: Get a reward from Brass Buckshot

quests.name: Return the pistol
quests.description: If somepony finds my lost gun, please bring it back. Reward guaranteed

stages.text: Return the pistol to its owner

quests.name: Star blaster
quests.description: Have you ever heard a story about a weapon that fell from the stars? Let them tell that this is just fairy tales! Maybe this weapon never actually fell from nowhere, but it definitely exists, and I have a proof - the ammunition that I found in the ruins of Manehattan. They do not fit any known model of weapons created by ponies or zebras, and I know this sort of things

stages.text: Show Brass Buckshot the Star blaster

quests.name: Fix AutoDoc
quests.description: Looks like the AutoDoc finally went to meet its maker. Fix it already, somepony! It`s in your best interests, you know!

stages.text: Report to Doc Sepsis and get a reward

quests.name: Collect 20 portions of fish oil
quests.description: I read in the old scientific journal about the benefits of fish oil, and I am willing to test this theory. The problem is that the nearest river is hundreds of miles away. Therefore, I`m ready to buy oil at a triple cost. But those who will try selling me melted radpig fat instead of fish oil, will become test subjects for verification of those potions without labels that were found in the factory

stages.text: Bring fish oil and get a reward

quests.name: Find a working medical talisman
quests.description: Will buy an intact medical talisman. I understand that the item is valuable and rare and promise a corresponding reward

stages.text: Bring Doc the talisman and get a reward

quests.name: Obtain recipes for potent drugs
quests.description: I offer a monetary reward to those ponies that can share the recipes for Party-Time Mint-als, Stampede and Ultra-Dash. Special information for those who like jokes about drug trafficking doctors: Doc Sepsis Clinic does not offer discounts to patients whose injuries were acquired during a conflict with the owner of the clinic

stages.text: Find a recipe of Party-Time Mint-als
Give copies of the recipes to Doc and get a reward

quests.name: Help with dynamite production
quests.description: I gonna start producing dynamite. Folks, share if you have, or help me get the components

stages.text: Find or prepare some more acid
Give components to Smoky Pit and get a reward

quests.name: Destroy the ant nests
quests.description: I gonna say it again - those ants will soon become a pain in the ass for all of us. If you don`t give a shit, I myself gonna pay to anypony who finds and blows up all the fucking ant nests. You can get the dynamite from me|I gonna say it again - those ants will soon become a pain in the neck for all of us. If you don`t care, I myself gonna pay to anypony who finds and blows up all the fricking ant nests. You can get dynamite from me

stages.text: Get a reward from Smoky Pit

quests.name: Cryotechnology
quests.description: A new type of explosives, coming soon! For reals! There is a tiny-winy thing left, just get them materials, get it together and test it in battle

stages.text: Obtain cryo-cells from the laboratory in an abandoned stable
Report to Smoky Pit about test results

quests.name: Find schematics of a doomsday grenade
quests.description: How about a little fair trade? For anypony who snatches me schematics of the doomsday grenade, that`s made from Sparkle-cola, I will give drawings of my own creation - even more demolishing mine

stages.text: Share a copy of the schematics with Smoky Pit and get rewarded

quests.name: Smoking accessories
quests.description: I`m fed up smoking these crap cigarettes. Who brings me some cooler smokes, gets a bunch of caps

quests.name: Collect precious stones
quests.description: I am looking for especially rare precious stones. They are larger than usual and have pronounced magical properties. I will pay you generously. And I need ordinary ones as well

stages.text: Bring all the stones to Dusty Nebula and get a reward

quests.name: Library
quests.description: I am buying intact pre-war books for the best price. Any will do, providing they can be read. Who brings the most, receives a special reward. Reading is magic, yay!

stages.text: Find all five volumes of the "Celestial Mechanics"
Talk to Dusty about the reward

quests.name: Collect Potion Ingredients
quests.description: I am looking for ingredients for one peculiar potion. Who helps with collecting them, gets its recipe in reward

stages.text: Give Dusty the ingredients and get the recipe

quests.name: Looking for mole rat fat
quests.description: I am buying mole rat fat at a good price to be used as a lubricant for mechanisms

quests.name: Find tools
quests.description: I am buying rare tools. I require: calipers, a hydraulic bolt cutter and an oscilloscope. I`ll pay well for each

quests.name: Collect old electronic devices
quests.description: Attention to those engaged in scavenging all sorts of ruins and junkyards! I need old electrical devices that can be dismantled for spare parts. Slightly broken ones will do, but no complete garbage please

stages.text: Bring all obtained stuff to Winry

quests.name: Screws and nuts
quests.description: Tired of digging out rusty bolts and nuts from old fans, I`m willing to buy new ones. But don`t even think of bringing them one by one, I need a whole box. This stuff, in theory, can be found somewhere in the old factory

stages.text: Find a box of new screws
Find a box of new nuts
Bring everything to Winry and get a reward

quests.name: Value of information
quests.description: I am looking for technical documentation on equidroids. For one who will be brave enough to sneak into the data storage room of the abandoned stable - the reward will be worth an effort

stages.text: Hack the main server and download data on equidroids
Bring the data disc to Winry and get a reward

quests.name: "Cyberpony" Magazine
quests.description: I`m looking for pre-war magazines "Cyberpony". They are very rare, they only came out during a single year and in small batches. I`ll pay for each, but anypony who brings all twelve numbers will receive a special reward

quests.name: Canterlot Alchemy
quests.description: I need help collect rare alchemical ingredients that can be obtained only from Canterlot monsters. This is a very dangerous work, but I`ll give the Elixir of intuition recipe in reward

stages.text: Bring everything to Zambezi and get collect your reward

quests.name: Water talisman
quests.description: Covertsign lacks a source of clean water. The water talisman could solve the problem, but these components are very rare and valuable. We know for certain that one talisman can be found in Canterlot, but it seems that alicorns made themselves a lair there. Anypony who dares to get a water talisman will do the whole settlement an invaluable favor

stages.text: Give Zambezi the water talisman and get a reward

quests.name: Hydroponics
quests.description: I need data on hydroponic farms from the Canterlot Stable-Tec office

stages.text: Give the data to scribe Amaranth and receive the reward

quests.name: Data on the stealth-buck M2
quests.description: The main Ministry of Image office, which in the past developed a stealth-buck, possibly still stores some data on a prototype of the stealth-buck M2 (the second model is much more advanced than the first one). I`ll pay you well for any information found

stages.text: Retrieve data about the stealth-buck M2

quests.name: Motivators RX-47
quests.description: We really need spare parts for robots, namely the motivators RX-47. They can be obtained from any robot of the "Guardian" class

quests.name: Balefire-battery
quests.description: Since we are now at war with Neighara Rangers, we need a powerful source of energy to properly equip our base. One of the balefire-batteries, collecting dust somewhere in a Bunker storage, will do

stages.text: Exchange the balefire-battery for a reward

quests.name: Technologies of the future
quests.description: If any faction owns technologies more advanced than those of Steel Rangers, then this undoubtedly is the Pegasus Enclave. Samples of such technology will be generously paid for

quests.name: Enclave armor
quests.description: The Enclave`s power armor is an impressive example of modern technology. I would like to get at least one intact sample

quests.name: Rare alcohol
quests.description: I`m buying rare pre-war alcohol made from apples. I am interested in the very elite drinks, leave cheap hooch for yourself
